sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chatbots to autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use. Highlighted how LangGraph enables developers to build reliable agent workflows with state management and human-in-the-loop controls.

sources.author: Clemens Siebert
sources.headline: Head of AI Platform @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on scaling AI infrastructure at Notion, focusing on cost optimization strategies for LLM inference and the importance of building robust evaluation pipelines before deploying agents to production.

sources.author: Sully Chen
sources.headline: Founder @ Replit
sources.post_summary: Explored how AI coding agents are transforming software development workflows, emphasizing the shift from autocomplete to full autonomous feature implementation and the new challenges around code review and security.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction
sources.post_summary: Analyzed the emerging AI infrastructure stack, comparing different approaches to agent memory, tool integration, and orchestration layers. Stressed that the real bottleneck is moving from demos to reliable production systems.

sources.author: Alex Hormozi
sources.headline: Founder @ Acquisition.com | Author of $100M Offers
sources.post_summary: Discussed building outbound systems that scale without increasing headcount, emphasizing automation layers on top of manual processes. Shared how his portfolio companies use sequenced touches and data enrichment to boost reply rates while maintaining personalization.

sources.author: Elena Verna
sources.headline: Growth Advisor | Former CMO @ Amplitude, SurveyMonkey
sources.post_summary: Explained how modern GTM engineering teams combine product-led and sales-led motions using automated workflows. Highlighted the importance of aligning content strategy with buyer journey stages to reduce CAC and improve pipeline velocity.

sources.author: Rick Nucci
sources.headline: Co-Founder & CEO @ Guru | ex-Google
sources.post_summary: Shared lessons on building a revenue operations function that treats sales, marketing, and CS as one system. Covered how his team uses data pipelines and automation to create closed-loop feedback between content performance and pipeline outcomes.

sources.author: Nadia Alami
sources.headline: Head of Growth @ Clay | ex-Notion
sources.post_summary: Detailed how outbound automation at Clay uses enrichment + intent signals to trigger personalized sequences. Emphasized building GTM infrastructure that allows non-technical teams to launch experiments without engineering tickets.

sources.author: David Gerhardt
sources.headline: Co-Founder @ Postscript | Revenue Leader
sources.post_summary: Wrote about evolving from manual outbound to engineered systems that combine content, automation, and sales ops. Shared metrics showing how structured content repurposing improved reply rates and shortened sales cycles.

sources.author: Arpit Mohan
sources.headline: Founder & CEO at Attestiv | Ex-Amazon
sources.post_summary: Shared his journey of pivoting from a corporate role at Amazon to founding a startup focused on AI-powered document verification. Highlighted the challenges of building the first MVP solo, iterating based on early user feedback, and the decision to ship publicly despite an incomplete product.

sources.author: Vic Vijayakumar
sources.headline: Solo Founder building AI tools | Prev. Stripe
sources.post_summary: Posted a detailed thread about going solo after leaving Stripe, building and launching three micro-SaaS products in six months. Covered his weekly shipping cadence, how he validates ideas quickly, and the tradeoffs of staying solo versus hiring early.

sources.author: Maya Sharma
sources.headline: Software Engineer → Indie Maker | Building in Public
sources.post_summary: Documented her transition from a traditional software engineering job to full-time indie development. Shared weekly updates on her current project, including user acquisition experiments, revenue milestones, and lessons from failed launches.

sources.author: Liam Torres
sources.headline: Founder at Relay | Shipping in public
sources.post_summary: Wrote about the process of rebuilding his product from scratch after the initial version failed to gain traction. Included transparent metrics on user signups, churn, and how public accountability helped him stay consistent through multiple pivots.

sources.author: Priya Patel
sources.headline: Ex-Marketer turned Full-Stack Developer
sources.post_summary: Shared her story of leaving marketing to teach herself to code and land her first developer role within nine months. Focused on the practical steps she took, side projects she shipped publicly, and how she leveraged her non-traditional background.
